question.prompt: Chris’ birthday is on a Thursday this year. What day of the week will it be \(60\) days after her birthday?

solutions.explanation:
The days of the week repeat every \(7\) days. Since
\[
60=8\times7+4,
\]
\(60\) days is \(8\) complete weeks followed by \(4\) more days. After the complete weeks it is Thursday again. The next four days are Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and Monday.

Thus the answer is \(\boxed{\text{Monday}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
solutions.title: Remove complete weeks
